# TrueNorth ITG

> TrueNorth ITG delivers HIPAA-compliant healthcare IT solutions including managed services, cloud infrastructure, and custom software development for clinics and hospitals.

TrueNorth ITG specializes in healthcare IT consulting, EMR/EHR support, and managed cloud services with expertise in Microsoft Azure, VMware, and disaster recovery. The company serves healthcare providers ranging from federally qualified health centers to large hospital networks with a focus on compliance, uptime optimization, and data protection.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA Compliance
- Healthcare IT Consulting
- EMR/EHR Implementation
- Managed Services
- Cloud Infrastructure
- Microsoft Azure
- VMware
- Disaster Recovery
- Healthcare Cloud Migration
- Data Protection
- Hybrid Cloud
- IaaS
- Epic Managed Services
- Healthcare AI Solutions
- Virtual Desktop Services
